May 18, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
Putnam Investments Llc increased its stake in Marathon Petroleum Corp (MPC) by 319.75% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Putnam Investments Llc bought 435,444 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.83% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 571,627 shares of the integrated oil company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $37.72 million, up from 136,183 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Putnam Investments Llc who had been investing in Marathon Petroleum Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $36.80 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.29% or $1.04 $79.67. About 1.70 million shares traded. Marathon Petroleum Corporation (NYSE:MPC) has risen 49.25% uptrending. It has outperformed by 37.70% the S&P500.

The institutional investor held 6,150 shares of the railroads company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $825,000, down from 9,265 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
